items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) did not practice for the second straight day. McVay said he is not making great progress and team being cautious; not long-term but another absence likely.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; McVay: not making great progress, erring on caution (no hernia).
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated to clear alpha WR1 with massive target share.
items.opportunity: Adams 142 routes/42% tgt share without Nacua; produced 8-195-2 Monday.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) did not practice for the second straight day and is trending toward a second consecutive absence.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after Grade 1 strain; history of soft-tissue issues.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz remains primary pass-catcher target.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share / 30% routes targeted last week without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery (MCL/PCL/meniscus damage, ACL intact); season-ending for regular season, possible playoff return.
items.why: Official transaction after multi-ligament damage confirmed; full recovery expected 2027.
items.implication: Jameis Winston takes over as Giants QB1; impacts all NYG pass-catchers ROS.
items.opportunity: Volume to Wan'Dale, Nabers, etc. under Winston; streaming QB options elsewhere.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) missed a second straight practice; looking like another absence for the Brazil game vs Cowboys.
items.why: Aggravated Aug 20 hamstring; not full practice since Week 1 explosion; travel to Brazil complicates.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth and slot/outside roles shift; monitor Ja'Kobi Lane etc.
items.opportunity: Reduced Flowers targets open for other Ravens pass-catchers in high-total spot.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is back on the practice field after good MRI results and expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI; suited up and participating; self-reported expectation to play.
items.implication: Full workload expected; no major role change for backups.
items.opportunity: Maintains elite RB1 status; reverse any handcuff hype.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 career games); Chuba Hubbard firmly in lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: Chronic issues; pushes Hubbard to clear lead back.
items.implication: Hubbard every-week RB2/flex with volume; Dillon handcuff.
items.opportunity: Hubbard high snap/touch share; Carolina pass-heavy but run opportunities.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua, targeted on 60 (42%). Production: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2 in the two games Nacua missed.
items.why: Route and target share data with Nacua off field; elite efficiency and volume.
items.implication: Adams locked WR1/elite start with or without Nacua short-term; massive ceiling.
items.opportunity: 42% target share, high aDOT potential in McVay offense.

items.text: Drake London averages >20 PPR, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game across 12 career starts with Michael Penix (who looked sharp in TNF return).
items.why: Historical efficiency and volume with Penix healthy; TNF confirmation of chemistry.
items.implication: London locked elite WR1 with Penix under center.
items.opportunity: High target share, yards, TDs in revitalized ATL offense.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert (MCL sprain) expected to miss multiple weeks; avoided IR. Zach Ertz signed to PS as depth.
items.why: MCL sprain confirmed; few weeks, no IR yet. DNP Thursday.
items.implication: Johnny Mundt/E.J. Jenkins primary TEs short-term; Ertz depth.
items.opportunity: TE streaming/waiver for Mundt; Hurts/Eagles pass game slight downgrade.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs soft run D; prop and volume support.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 with smash spot ceiling.
items.opportunity: High carry volume expected; goal-line work.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% tgt share both games; RB7 util (86); PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yds.

Loves Chris Olave (vs LV, 10+ tgts both gms, 53% air yards, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% tgt share w/o Collins, IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts); Parker Washington (vs NE, 36% tgt share).
items.why: Volume metrics + matchup edges for each.
items.implication: Strong WR/TE starts; Schultz especially if Collins out.
items.opportunity: High target shares, RZ, aDOT advantages.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps); Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, JAX stout vs RBs); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest FPts to WRs, low team total); Rome Odunze (vs PHI: 12% tgt share, tough coverage/low total).
items.why: Poor roles/snaps or brutal matchups + low implied totals.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats; look for alternatives.
items.opportunity: Etienne/Stevenson role compression; McLaurin/Odunze volume risk.

items.text: After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield with 65% snaps and out-touched him 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead Week 3.
items.why: Post-fumble snap/touch takeover data; pass-pro trust still lagging for full lead.
items.implication: Henderson rising handcuff/flex value; monitor for more erosion of Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/touches; committee but rising share.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term.
